- Affiliation: Free City
- Occupation: Contract Records and Review
- Rank: Clerk
- Title: Food Ledger Clerk at Yangpyeong 1-dong
**Life.** Generation of 2126. She grew up beside the storehouse in Yangpyeong 1-dong. Her post as ledger clerk opened through counting the storehouse stock to the very end on a midwinter night.
- Work location: Yangpyeong 1-dong. At the ledger desk in Yangpyeong 1-dong, Jang Pilgyu cross-checks the food and fuel counts of the storehouse copy against the area copy and records the circumstances of any missing ledger entry.

**Office.** Rank: Clerk. Title: Food Ledger Clerk at Yangpyeong 1-dong. She sends ledger copies to the storehouse and the area at the same time, but the final confirmation of removal quantities requires the clerk's seal.

**Anecdote.** In midwinter, when the storehouse food ran short, Jang Pilgyu spent the night cross-checking the ledger with the area representatives and recorded the confirmed quantity in the audit column.

**Relationships.** He cooperates with Yun Seorin by exchanging ratified contract copies but competes with her over interpretive authority, he disputes the wording of termination conditions with Jeong Yura, and he owes Yi Seodam a debt for covering up a past ledger omission.

**Ambition.** She aims to standardize the removal criteria of every western storehouse on the ledgers she has cross-checked herself.

**Fear.** That a single forged food ticket could invalidate an entire storehouse ledger and bring the ledger audit down as a political tool.

**Intervention.** You can find the forged ration ticket to protect his seal, or expose his marginal interpretation notes to neutralize the winter fuel release clause.
